title: 第810章 先游街再普渡
slug: 宗门收徒我能看见属性词条
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

南瞻部洲，青溪山。

先是一片金光祥云从西方缓缓飘荡而来。

阳光落垂，青山依旧，好似一片美景，加之祥云一片更是祥瑞至极。

一位练气期的邪灵教成员目光眺望，心中顿时也升起万千感叹，虽然身为邪修，手中也沾满了一片污血，但是看见这缤纷万千的时刻，总会感觉内心会受到净化。

同时也会升起一个念头——这邪修乍一看前路渺茫，但现在看看怎么不算还有一片光明前景？

祥云愈发逼近，霞光也炫彩夺目。

邪灵教成员目光也难得露出些许温和神情。

虽然加入这个邪灵教并不算太久，但是他如今也已经备受组织上的信任。

前些日子屠了两个村，献祭了数百人提炼血气。

他算不得出了多少力气，但是由于资质远超寻常人，他分得了其他人整整两倍的额外奖励。

那一日他握着那一块让人血液翻涌的血石，感受着里面不知多少条生命精炼而来的力量，感受着那些力量化为自己手中的血气……

这位邪灵教成员心中只剩下唯一的感叹——下次他一定多出力气。

他人血骨做阶梯，一步一踏登天路。

昔日枷锁皆做空，始知前路命铺成。

现在前路明了，只需按部就班，献上那群无知凡民的性命，让他一步一步登至巅峰，这方世间任谁见了也需向自己低头。

以前渴望不上的，将来都会唾手可得。

就例如昔日村头瞧他不起的翠花，他现在也瞧不起了，也早就化作他体内力量的一部分。

他望向天边祥云，此刻在他目光之中，那一片祥云暗暗化作汹涌的血气，而他站在血气之中，只是一只手来就能招来风雨。

但是很快，这邪修的目光就变得瞬间惊恐。

因为那一片祥云之中竟然真的伸出了一只手。

那是一只金灿灿，周手流转着璀璨佛光的大手，从那一片祥云之中缓慢递出。

手明明是那般的慢，可只是眨了两眼就已经从云端递到了眼前。

此刻才明白这只手到底有多大，遮天蔽日，金光熠熠，仿比这他们藏匿的青溪山一处山体还大。

威压如虹，宛如天罚。

坏消息，这掌货真价实，散发的威压就让他快匍匐在地，这一掌就算有一万个他也只会化作齑粉。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Looking south to Buzhou and Qingxi Mountain.

First, a golden auspicious cloud floated slowly from the west.

The sun is setting, the green mountains are still there, it is like a beautiful scenery, and the auspicious clouds are even more auspicious.

A member of the Evil Spirit Cult who was in the Qi-training stage looked at it, and he suddenly felt countless sighs in his heart. Although he was an evil cultivator and his hands were stained with blood, he always felt that his heart would be purified when he saw this colorful moment.

At the same time, a thought will arise - at first glance, this evil cultivator seems to have a bleak future, but now it seems that it does not have a bright future?

The auspicious clouds are getting closer and closer, and the glow is also dazzling.

The members of the Evil Spirit Cult also rarely showed a gentle look in their eyes.

Although he joined this evil spirit sect not long ago, he is now highly trusted by the organization.

A few days ago, two villages were slaughtered and hundreds of people were sacrificed to refine their blood.

He couldn't count how much effort he put into it, but because his qualifications were far beyond ordinary people, he received twice as much extra reward as the others.

That day, he held the blood stone that made people's blood surge, feeling the power refined from countless lives inside, and feeling that power turned into the blood in his hands...

The member of the Evil Spirit Cult had only one sigh left in his heart - he must try harder next time.

The blood and bones of others are used as stairs to climb to heaven step by step.

The shackles of the past were all in vain, but now I know that the road ahead is paved.

Now that the road ahead is clear, he just needs to follow the steps, sacrifice the lives of those ignorant people, and let him reach the top step by step. Anyone in this world must bow to him.

Things that were beyond our reach in the past will be within our reach in the future.

For example, the green flowers that he looked down upon in the village in the past were looked down upon by him now, and they had long since become part of the power in his body.

He looked at the auspicious clouds on the horizon. In his eyes at this moment, the auspicious clouds turned into surging blood energy. And standing in the blood energy, he could attract wind and rain with just one hand.

But soon, the evil cultivator's eyes became instantly frightened.

Because a hand actually stretched out from among the auspicious clouds.

It was a big golden hand with bright Buddha light flowing around it, and it was slowly extended from the auspicious cloud.

The hand was obviously so slow, but it was already handed from the cloud to the eyes in just a few blinks.

At this moment, I realized how big this hand was. It covered the sky and the sun, and shone with golden light. It seemed to be bigger than the Qingxi Mountain where they were hiding.

The pressure is like a rainbow, like a punishment from heaven.

Bad news, this palm is real. The pressure it exudes makes him crawl to the ground. Even if there are 10,000 palms, he will only turn into powder.
